title: P0.34: Optional prebuild must reuse fresh resource snapshots
description: Live proof after the Control/UIBridge birth fix showed a 44s UI stall while optional lazy VM prebuild repeatedly launched Windows resource probes. Resource telemetry must protect responsiveness, not create more contention than the work it governs.
resume_hint: Completed in local Windows runtime. _refresh_prebuild_snapshot_async() now returns whether it spawned work and skips expensive PowerShell/CIM probes when a cached snapshot is fresh or a refresh was recently attempted. The lazy prebuild chain reuses the snapshot between routes.
next_action: Restart IABV through the desktop shortcut and verify runtime_audit no longer reports a ~44s stall with snapshot_refresh_in_flight between lazy_vm_prebuild_evolution_done and lazy_vm_prebuild_knowledge_start.
reason: A universal metacognitive loop must budget its own sensors. If observation consumes the UI event loop, the organism loses communication and cannot learn from the user's corrections.
